why: The must_not list has one item: an issue that has no regression test line for the empty-list bug. I checked the expect list for such a line. It has two. One says "`npm test` exits 0 and its output shows at least one test under test/ that calls average([]) and asserts the result is 0". The other is a "Regression guard" line: if average's body is put back to the original, `npm test` must exit non-zero. Both lines have run proofs. One proof greps test/ for average([]) inside an assertion. The other restores the old math.js and expects a failing test. The outcome also says the suite "has a test for average that catches this bug if it comes back." So the output does not do the forbidden thing.
